stops.name: Umbalfälle
stops.detail: The Umbal Waterfalls are waterfalls of the upper reaches of the Isel (still called Umbalbach there) in the Umbal Valley west of Hinterbichl in the Hohe Tauern National Park in Austria.

stops.name: Wasserschaupfad
stops.detail: At these alpine pastures, the water nature trail begins along the Umbal Waterfalls with several viewing platforms and explanatory display boards.
